groups.heading: CPython legacy 1.0-3.7 (proven-correct: recompile-equivalence or structural token-match)
groups.axis_label: proven-correct decompiles over the legacy band, %

bars.label: proven-correct

verified_by.conditional: The published figure itself is gated unconditionally: the run asserts both corpora exist, then asserts proven-correct at or above this bar's own numerator regardless of environment. Only the stronger leg is conditional. The recompile-equivalence ratchet is skipped when no legacy CPython interpreter is present, printing `skip: no legacy interpreter present`, and CI provisions no CPython 1.0 through 3.7, so on a clean machine the figure is held by structural token-match alone. That is what this bar's heading already claims, recompile-equivalence or structural token-match, so the claim and its enforcement agree.

bars.detail: CI floor 150 / 191 (asserted, token-match alone holds when the 1.0-3.7 interpreter zoo is absent); 166 / 191 measured locally with the full period interpreter zoo (67 recompile-equiv + 99 token-match)
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-py-decompile/tests/legacy_recompile.rs:31 (PROVEN_CORRECT_FLOOR 150, CI-enforced via the test job); 166/191 measured locally 2026-06-12 with python 1.0-3.12 present

bars.label: proven-correct (local, full period interpreter set)
bars.detail: 166 / 191 proven correct when every period interpreter is installed (67 recompile-equivalent plus 99 structural token-match). No gate asserts this number; it depends on which 1.0-3.7 interpreters are present, so it is a local measurement and is labeled local wherever it is published.
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-py-decompile/tests/legacy_recompile.rs run locally 2026-06-12 with python 1.0-3.12 present; the CI-asserted figure is the 150 / 191 floor in the bar above

bars.detail: 133 of 133 functions in the 38 PARSEABLE corpus modules are fully op-covered (every operator lowered, output re-parses); 2 corpus modules are skipped on wat-parse/sig-extract failure (malformed corpus source the reference assembler also rejects), so this is 100% of the supported subset, NOT of all wasm; separately, 57 of 57 execution-eligible functions are EXECUTION-EQUIVALENT under wasmtime (original vs recovered: return values, trap parity, linear memory; 6 byte-identical), the remainder op-coverage-only

groups.heading: JVM classfile (EdgeCases corpus, per-method real-javac recompile)
groups.axis_label: methods over the 131-method EdgeCases corpus, %; read each bar's own grading tier, because recompile-acceptance and execution-equivalence are different standards

bars.label: per-method
bars.detail: CI floor 131 of 131 (every top-level method recompiles error-free) measured under real javac attribution; the pickWord switch-expression lift (9afa2306) unmasked 25 latent defects previously hidden by javac parse-masking from the __unresolved__ token, all fixed by class: pattern-switch subject resolved to its source parameter (sealed-subtype exhaustiveness), sealed/permits emitted on inner type stubs, typed default initializers on final inner-stub fields, the Exceptions attribute threaded into a real throws clause, the loop-exhausted terminal emitted after a while loop whose exit is a shared pure-return tail, loop-captured locals hoisted to a fresh final declaration, and the shared return tail of an instanceof if-else-if chain duplicated under a Region-tree fall-through analysis
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/decompile_recompile_rate.rs (report_per_method_javac_recompile asserts ok >= PER_METHOD_JAVAC_OK_FLOOR 131 of PER_METHOD_JAVAC_TOTAL 131); CI runs it via the test job with actions/setup-java (JDK 25); floor measured 2026-06-22 after fixing the pickWord-unmasked defects

bars.label: per-method, execution-verified
bars.detail: 117 of the same 131 top-level methods are EXECUTION-equivalent, which is a strictly stronger standard than the recompile bar beside it: the original and the recovered source are each compiled by real javac, both are run under a real JVM, and every observable per-method result is compared. Read the residual 14 as the two separate populations it is, never as one: 8 methods are javac-clean and measurably DIVERGENT, and 6 are javac-clean but not executable in isolation (5 measure a nested-type stub, 1 is not self-reproducible), so those 6 are ungraded rather than passing. The distinction is not academic in this crate, which once emitted a method that compiled cleanly and incremented a counter twice on its exception path.
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/edgecases_execution_differential.rs (EXECUTION_EQUIVALENT_FLOOR 117 of PER_METHOD_TOTAL 131, with the equivalent set pinned as a membership list of method names rather than a count, so a method cannot leave it silently and the pinned-divergent lists only ever shrink); the reference is real javac plus a real JVM comparing observable behavior, never the decompiler's own output; the_execution_differential_reports_a_double_counted_exception_path injects a second counter increment on divSafe's recovered exception path and requires this differential to report divergence while javac still accepts the file; measured 117 equivalent, 8 divergent, 6 not driven on JDK 25

groups.heading: Dalvik recovered bodies (committed dex corpus, real JVM verifier)

bars.label: verifier-clean (committed, CI)
bars.detail: 118 of 118 PRESENTABLE classes in the committed EdgeCases/EdgeCasesKt/Hello dex pass the real JVM bytecode verifier (-Xverify:all) with 0 lifter verify failures, so the plotted figure is the presentable ratio. State the other denominator too: the corpus holds 155 classes and 37 of them are link-skipped, never reaching the verifier because they reference supertypes the harness does not bundle, Kotlin's Function1 among them. That is a harness limit rather than a lifter defect, but it means 118 of 155 classes are verifier-attested and the remaining 37 are ungraded, not passing. A live-range-splitting pass recovers bodies with conflicting register types across joins, and 317 re-hosted method bodies verify clean with 0 failures, every non-stub recovered body re-hosted into an Object carrier and run through -Xverify:all. Floor 118 classes; the reference is the JVM rejecting malformed bytecode, not the lifter's own report.
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/dalvik_verifier_gate.rs (VERIFY_CLEAN_CLASS_FLOOR 118, LIFTER_VERIFY_FAIL_CEILING 0, LINK_SKIPPED_CEILING 37, COMMITTED_CORPUS_CLASSES 155, BODY_VERIFY_CLEAN_FLOOR 317, BODY_VERIFY_FAIL_CEILING 0); reference = -Xverify:all over assemble_jar output, not the lifter self-report; measured 118 of 118 verifiable classes with 37 link-skipped and 317 re-hosted bodies clean on JDK 25, so each floor is pinned at the figure the corpus measures rather than beneath it

bars.label: body-lowering (real apks, local)

verified_by.conditional: the three apks are gitignored, so this gate re-measures only when DISROBE_RUN_REAL_APK_TESTS=1 and all three are present under corpus/mobile/apk/inbox; CI cannot re-derive either figure, and the numbers it pins are cross-checked against this file by dalvik_body_attest_bar_matches_the_pins_this_gate_enforces, which does run in CI

bars.detail: Two separate populations, stated separately. Self-reported body lowering: 82788 of 89516 defined methods across the three apks get a lowered body rather than a throw-stub, which is the lifter counting its own output (transmissionic 26192 of 27805 = 94.2, rustdesk 29376 of 32410 = 90.6, enrecipes 27220 of 29301 = 92.9). Verifier-attested: 2960 of 2994 recovered bodies presented to the real JVM pass -Xverify:all = 98.9 (transmissionic 980 of 993, rustdesk 1205 of 1216, enrecipes 775 of 785). The attested denominator is not the method count: 82756 non-stub candidate bodies, a deterministic 100-permille sample takes 8343, and 2994 of those can be re-hosted into an isolated Object carrier, so 5349 are excluded by harness limits and are ungraded rather than passing (1400 constructors, 1672 invokespecial receivers, 2128 unresolvable framework dependencies, 149 other). The apks are gitignored, so both figures are local; the committed-dex bar above is the CI-enforced attestation and its denominator is classes, not bodies.
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/dalvik_realworld_body_attest.rs (REAL_APK_METHOD_TOTAL 89516 and ATTESTED_PRESENTED 2994 pinned by equality, SELF_REPORTED_BODY_FLOOR 82788, ATTESTED_CLEAN_FLOOR 2960, ATTESTED_FAIL_CEILING 34, per-apk pins in common::REAL_APKS) and crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/dex2jar_realworld_apks.rs (per-apk self-reported numerator floors against equality-pinned method totals); reference for the attested figure = java -Xverify:all rejecting malformed bytecode, not the lifter self-report

groups.heading: Detection and extraction breadth (counts, not percentages)
groups.axis_label: families detected vs reversed or extracted in-tree

bars.label: Containers
bars.source: ContainerKind enum crates/disrobe-binfmt/src/container.rs (ContainerKind::ALL is [Self; 100], 100 real variants excluding None); all 100 write member bytes in-tree per ContainerKind::extracted_in_tree_count, asserted in crates/disrobe-binfmt/src/container.rs tests detected_count_is_one_hundred (container.rs:1438) and every_real_format_extracts_in_tree (container.rs:1444) (0 metadata-summary-only, 0 external-tool-gated); the superset spans archives/installers (ZIP/tar/7z/RAR/cab/MSI/NSIS/deb/rpm/Docker/OCI/ISO), bare single-stream compression (gz/bz2/zst/lzma/lzip/lz4-frame/zlib/.Z), legacy archives (ar/arj/arc/lzh/lzop/uzip/xamarin-xalz/par2/ELF-overlay carve), embedded-linux filesystems (squashfs/cramfs/ext4/romfs/minixfs/jffs2/ubi-ubifs/yaffs/erofs/ntfs/android-sparse/btrfs-send), disk-image/partition containers (GPT/MBR/VHD/VHDX/WIM walked through FAT), and vendor firmware decryptors (D-Link AES/EnGenius XOR/Autel table/QNAP PC1 plus CRC-verified Netgear/Xiaomi/Tesla carves); a recursive carve-everything engine (multi-magic scan, chunk model, depth recursion, entropy gating) drives nested extraction. InnoSetup writes the decoded setup-data block stream (per-file split via the version-specific TSetupHeader parse is the documented limit) and InstallShield writes its stored and zlib members; the arj/arc/stuffit/partclone heavy codecs are carved verbatim with a documented note

bars.label: .NET protectors
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-dotnet/src/protectors.rs detect_all ([Protector; 23]); ConfuserEx2 constant decryption is reversed on a REAL committed sample - confuserex2_full.rs:53 recovers the encrypted plaintext from SampleConstants.confuserex2.dll with a plaintext-absent oracle; its encrypted-resource layer is carved byte-exact but runtime-key-walled (real_confuserex2_resources.rs:54 BlobExtractedKeyedWall) and full ConfuserEx2 cleanup delegates to de4dot (confuserex2_full.rs:47); the Eazfuscator VM-tier is devirtualized on a committed assembly - real_eazvm.rs devirtualizes_every_method_to_ordered_cil recovers the per-build opcode table from the in-assembly dispatch, decrypts the position-keyed stream and lifts all five virtualized bodies to CIL, graded against the independently compiled clean DLL by an ordered instruction comparison (opcode and operand, branch targets resolved to instruction index) at 57/57 = 100%, with recovered_cil_reinjects_and_runs_identically rebuilding a runnable assembly from the recovered CIL whose stdout is byte-identical to the clean baseline (skipped only when no .NET runtime is on PATH, never silently passed); the KoiVM (ConfuserEx-lineage) VM-tier is devirtualized on a committed sample produced by the real KoiVM tool (TheProxyRE fork driven through its public Virtualizer api over a benign self-authored exe, not a self-made encoder) - real_koivm.rs lifts all six virtualized bodies out of the #Koi stream back to CIL and grades them against the independently compiled KoiSample.clean.exe (peel_delivered_bodies_recover_known_originals: Add and Square recover fully, aggregate structural recovery >= 75% vs hand-derived ground-truth ops in koivm/grade.rs, a non-circular oracle), with clean_baseline_has_no_koivm_summary asserting the unobfuscated baseline yields no KoiVM summary; ILProtector and MaxToCode are detected and structurally enumerated with their method bodies walled on the native-runtime key, derived in the loader and absent from the assembly, never fabricated (ilprotector_bodies.rs NativeRuntimeWall, maxtocode_bodies.rs NativeStubWall); remainder detected + classified

groups.heading: Secret recall on the committed planted APK (both tools read the same file)

bars.detail: 8 of 8 planted secrets recalled from corpus/recon/apk/planted-secrets.apk. The eight are named individually in this bar's membership list, so one secret cannot stop being found while another starts and leave the count at 8. bars.label: planted non-secret IOC categories
bars.detail: All 6 planted non-secret IOC categories are represented in the scan of corpus/recon/planted: endpoint, manifest, url, ipv4, email, and onion, with 31 findings in total across them (endpoint 13, manifest 7, url 7, email 2, ipv4 1, onion 1). Read this as category presence and not as per-item recall: a category counts once it yields at least one finding, so this figure says frisk covers every planted category, not that it finds every planted item inside one. The six are named individually and the denominator is pinned by equality against the category list the gate grades.
bars.source: benches/head-to-head/src/gate.rs test published_planted_ioc_category_bar_is_pinned_by_membership, which requires the published membership to equal the category list it grades so the row cannot describe a different six than the one measured
